Treatment chart

Clinic is its own door. Tap the sore spot, then Recovery methods. Each case has a gold-standard protocol with steps and Amazon kit links, plus support options that help but do not discharge.

Otitis / ear mites — drip + misses. Ear flush + mite drops.
Hot spot — bath with chlorhexidine, then clip / cone protocol.
Dietary indiscretion — weak treat refill. Hold food, then pumpkin.
Kennel cough (CIRDC) — bark recoil, can spread. Isolate, humidify, rest.
Anxiety — freeze / miss. Pressure wrap + quiet kennel.
Sprain — weak hits. Ice + crate rest.
Flea allergy — flea shampoo bath, then adulticide + comb.
Conjunctivitis — misses. Saline + eye drops.
Heat stress — shade + cool soak bath (or bowl dunk), then rest.
Torn nail — paw drip. Flush, wrap, rest.
Arthritis flare — weak hits. Warm pack, NSAID plan, rest.

You refill 12 treats each turn. Sniff Break is always free. This is a play-yard tussle — grit drops, nobody is actually harmed.
